$comment: CIT:404 PUBLIC METADATA ONLY challenge catalog. Contains NO flags, keys, solutions, hashes, passwords, private URLs, or organizer notes. Resource URLs that are not publicly known are null placeholders to be filled from the hosting/secret manager at packaging time. Score matrix: 1=50/10, 2=100/20, 3=150/30, 4=300/60 (reward CIT$ / core_energy CE). Difficulty is 1-5 stars.

resource_types.EXTERNAL: Player follows a link to an external platform or site.
resource_types.DOWNLOAD: Player downloads a sanitized artifact file.
resource_types.SERVICE: Player interacts with a live hosted service (HTTP or TCP).
resource_types.STATIC: Challenge is fully described in text; no artifact or service needed.
